psepri.title: PSEPRI — Philippine Social, Economic & Public Opinion Research Institute, Inc.
psepri.deckTitle: PSEPRI Investor Presentation 2026 & SPIN Network Partnership
psepri.partnershipSummary: The institutional partnership between Secure the Philippines Initiatives Network (SPIN Network) and the Philippine Social, Economic & Public Opinion Research Institute, Inc. (PSEPRI) establishes PSEPRI's capability to conduct and deliver reliable nationwide survey results through SPIN's regional network.

keyMetrics.label: Initial Capitalization
keyMetrics.detail: Structured across core setup (₱3.40M), reserve (₱3.85M), working capital (₱2.50M), launch (₱1.25M), and tech/brand (₱1.00M).

keyMetrics.label: 3-Year Revenue Trajectory
keyMetrics.detail: Projected growth from ₱13.5M in Year 1 to ₱25M in Year 2 and ₱40M in Year 3 across six verticals.

keyMetrics.label: Flagship National Survey
keyMetrics.detail: Multi-stage probability sampling across regional and provincial bureaus with face-to-face and online coverage.

keyMetrics.label: Privacy & Quality Standard
keyMetrics.detail: Full compliance with the Data Privacy Act, SEC, BIR, NPC, and PSA standards plus a 10-step quality assurance review.

slides.title: PSEPRI — Investor Presentation 2026
slides.caption: Philippine Social, Economic & Public Opinion Research Institute, Inc. — Independent Data, Philippine Insight.

slides.title: About PSEPRI — Credible Research & Data Intelligence
slides.caption: An independent, non-partisan Philippine research organization delivering reliable data, rigorous methodology, and actionable insights.

slides.title: Vision, Mission & Five Core Values
slides.caption: Anchored on Accuracy, Independence, Transparency, Confidentiality, and Scientific Methodology for Philippine society and economy.

slides.title: Investment Proposition — 3-Year Revenue Trajectory
slides.caption: Backed by ₱12M initial capitalization targeting ₱13.5M Year 1, ₱25M Year 2, and ₱40M Year 3 revenue with recurring IP and regional field capacity.

slides.title: The Philippine Market Opportunity
slides.caption: Serving a 118M+ population with an expanding middle class, active governance reforms, and growing demand for evidence-based decisions.

slides.title: Six Diversified Revenue Verticals
slides.caption: Social Research, Economic Research, Political & Public Opinion, Market Research, Data Analytics, and Consulting & Insights.

slides.title: Survey Packages & Pricing Tiers
slides.caption: Tiered study offerings spanning Basic Poll (₱100k–₱500k), Professional Survey (₱500k–₱2M), and National Research Study (₱800k–₱3M+).

slides.title: Signature Research Products & Publications
slides.caption: Led by The Philippine Public Opinion Index™ alongside five recurring indices covering Society, Economy, Government, and Public Affairs.

slides.title: Organizational Structure & Research Leadership
slides.caption: Governance from Board of Directors and President/CEO through the Chief Research Officer to specialized research, statistics, analytics, and field teams.

slides.title: Year 1 Staffing Plan — 15 to 19 Core Personnel
slides.caption: Expandable initial core team combining analysts, statisticians, field operations management, IT/data security, and communications.

slides.title: Data Privacy Act (RA 10173) & Research Ethics
slides.caption: Non-negotiable respondent privacy standards covering informed consent, data minimization, secure storage, and zero fabrication.

slides.title: Research Methodology & 10-Step Quality Assurance
slides.caption: Six-stage workflow from design and sampling through fieldwork, validation, and a 10-step quality assurance review.

slides.title: Philippine Regulatory Framework — SEC, BIR, NPC & PSA
slides.caption: Full institutional alignment with SEC corporate governance, BIR compliance, National Privacy Commission registration, and PSA standards.

slides.title: 12-Week Launch Plan — First National Survey
slides.caption: Phased 12-week rollout from questionnaire design and enumerator training to national fieldwork and public release of 1,500–2,000 responses.

slides.title: Flagship Survey Design & Probability Sampling
slides.caption: Covers economic conditions, household concerns, government services, and institutional trust using multi-stage probability sampling.

slides.title: Sample Questionnaire Structure
slides.caption: Six neutral, structured modules spanning screening, demographics, key issues, institutional satisfaction, public affairs, and closing.

slides.title: Five-Pillar Risk Management Framework
slides.caption: Proactive safeguards across Methodological, Operational, Data Security, Reputational, and Regulatory risk domains.

slides.title: 36-Month Growth Roadmap (Years 1–3)
slides.caption: Establish baseline surveys in Year 1, expand regional hubs in Year 2, and institutionalize a national research database in Year 3.

slides.title: Strategic Investment Proposal Summary
slides.caption: Building a high-impact data intelligence institution with diversified revenue streams and accountable governance.

slides.title: ₱12,000,000 Initial Capitalization Breakdown
slides.caption: Allocated across Core Setup (₱3.40M), Research Launch (₱1.25M), Technology & Brand (₱1.00M), Working Capital (₱2.50M), and Reserve (₱3.85M).

slides.title: Institutional Partnership — SPIN Network × PSEPRI
slides.caption: Combining PSEPRI's research methodology with SPIN Network's nationwide regional chapters for reliable survey execution.

slides.title: Official PSEPRI Identification Card Template (Front & Back)
slides.caption: Standardized field enumerator and staff ID card layout featuring QR verification, TIN/SSS/emergency fields, and authorized signatory block.
